job_description:
Position: AI Engineer – Machine Learning & NLP

Company: TechVision AI Solutions
Location: Da Nang, Vietnam
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience: 0–2 years
Salary: 15,000,000 – 25,000,000 VND/month

ABOUT THE COMPANY

TechVision AI Solutions is a technology company specializing in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and intelligent software solutions.

We develop AI-powered applications that help businesses automate processes, analyze data, and improve operational efficiency.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, develop, and optimize Machine Learning and Deep Learning models.
- Build Natural Language Processing applications using Transformer-based architectures.
- Develop AI-powered applications using Large Language Models.
- Fine-tune pretrained models for specific business requirements.
- Collect, preprocess, and analyze datasets.
- Develop REST APIs using FastAPI.
- Integrate AI models into backend applications.
- Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics.
- Optimize inference speed, accuracy, and resource usage.
- Collaborate with software engineers and data scientists.
- Deploy AI models using Docker and cloud services.
- Maintain technical documentation.

REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or related fields.
- 0–2 years of experience in AI or Machine Learning.
- Strong Python programming skills.
- Understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms.
- Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Familiarity with NLP and Transformer architectures.
- Knowledge of data preprocessing and feature engineering.
- Basic understanding of REST APIs and FastAPI.
- Familiarity with Git and SQL.
- Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
- Experience with Hugging Face Transformers.
- Familiarity with Docker and cloud deployment.
- Understanding of MLOps and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience with speech recognition or computer vision.
- Participation in AI research projects, Kaggle competitions, or open-source projects.

BENEFITS

- Competitive salary and performance bonuses.
- Full insurance coverage.
- Professional training and mentorship.
- Opportunities to work on real-world AI projects.
- Flexible working environment.
- Clear career advancement opportunities.

APPLICATION PROCESS

1. Submit your CV.
2. Complete the technical assessment.
3. Attend the technical interview.
4. Participate in the HR interview.
5. Receive the employment offer.

We welcome passionate AI engineers who are eager to learn, innovate, and build intelligent solutions.

4. Thiết kế mô hình dữ liệu phân tích
Thiết kế và xây dựng Data Warehouse trên PostgreSQL phục vụ phân tích dữ liệu tập trung.

Xây dựng các bảng dữ liệu phục vụ phân tích như Fact Sales, Fact Inventory, Dim Date, Dim Product, Dim Customer, Dim Store và các bảng liên quan.

Tối ưu câu lệnh SQL, index, partition và chiến lược nạp dữ liệu khi cần thiết.
5. Quản trị chất lượng và tính tin cậy của dữ liệu
Xây dựng các quy tắc kiểm tra chất lượng dữ liệu: đầy đủ, hợp lệ, duy nhất, nhất quán và chính xác.

job_description:

cost and drive ROAS, revenue and profit. Working closely with the Product, Creative and Data teams, you will shape creative strategy, ASO and monetization to deliver sustainable, long-term growth for our AI, Health & Wellness and Utility products.

• Develop monthly/quarterly UA plans for our mobile apps, including performance evaluation and forecasting.
• Plan, manage and optimize UA campaigns across multiple channels (Google, Apple Search Ads, Facebook, TikTok, AppLovin, etc.) to achieve ROAS, revenue and profit KPIs.

• Analyze and optimize App Store Optimization (ASO) on both iOS and Android.
• Collaborate with Product and Creative teams to produce high-quality ads (videos, banners, playable ads), test variations and iterate based on performance data.
• Work with Product Owners and designers to analyze in-app user behavior, improve retention and optimize monetization strategies.

• Other tasks as assigned by the Team Lead/Manager.

• Proactive, responsible and eager to learn.
• Can-do attitude and growth mindset; able to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
